name: Psychology
about: Foundations of psychology and mental health practice, aimed at work in psychological counselling, personal development and well-being; ends with a thesis defence and an oral state exam.

name: International and European Legal Studies
about: How international and EU law shape business, diplomacy and society, with internships, small classes and mentoring from international faculty.

name: International Relations
about: International relations theory, global and domestic politics and philosophy, with an internship and thesis. Take the major or a concentration in Global Security Studies, International Law or Human Rights.

name: Business Administration
about: Management, marketing, finance, economics and leadership with internships. Take the major or a concentration: marketing and digital communications, entrepreneurship, global management, data analytics, or accounting, finance and ESG.

name: Humanities, Society and Culture
about: Philosophy, literature, history and the arts and how they shape society, with an internship and thesis. Take the major or a concentration in sociology and leadership, language and culture, or creative writing.

name: Journalism and Media Studies
about: Journalism combined with media studies, film studies, marketing and public relations, with an internship; a Public Relations and Marketing concentration is offered.

name: Visual Art Studies
about: Art history, curatorial studies and studio art together, giving a grounding in both the theory and the practice of the visual arts in Prague.

name: Authorial Acting
about: Acting and authorship studied together at the theatre faculty (DAMU): voice, speech, movement and dialogical acting, building towards your own texts and stage presentations rather than interpreting assigned roles.

name: Photography
about: Photography and visual art at FAMU, the film and TV school: the basics of photographic representation first, then specialised studios and genres, then a bachelor's thesis, with practice and theory side by side.

name: Dance Pedagogy - Methods of Classical Ballet Technique
about: Training to teach dance, with classical ballet technique as the focus: dance methodology and didactics for all ages, other dance styles, dance history, pedagogy, psychology and anatomy.

name: Dance Pedagogy - Methods of Modern and Contemporary Dance
about: Training to teach dance, with modern and contemporary dance technique as the focus: dance methodology and didactics for all ages, other dance styles, dance history, pedagogy, psychology and anatomy.

name: Dance Pedagogy - Methods of Folk Dance
about: Training to teach dance, with folk dance technique as the focus: dance methodology and didactics for all ages, other dance styles, dance history, pedagogy, psychology and anatomy.

name: Architecture and Urban Design
about: A four-year, studio-based bachelor's in architecture and urban design covering theory, technical and professional practice, with themes such as sustainability, climate resilience and housing.

name: Civil Engineering
about: A three-year civil engineering bachelor's specialised in building construction, taught at a faculty with its own materials and structures research centre (AdMaS) and close links to the construction industry.

name: Electrical Engineering
about: Electrical engineering with a choice of two specialisations: Electronics and Communication Technologies, or Power Systems and Automation, built on mathematics, physics and electronics.

name: Entrepreneurship and Small Business Development
about: A practice-led business bachelor's: marketing, management and finance in year one, then you build and run a company with a team through entrepreneurial practice courses.

name: Fundamentals of Mechanical Engineering
about: A broad engineering bachelor's: mathematics, physics, materials, CAD and machine design first, then mechanics and manufacturing, before choosing a specialised master's.

name: Civil Engineering
about: Four years of structural and building engineering: two years of science and core courses, then design projects and electives in concrete, steel, timber and masonry structures, building materials and building services, ending in a bachelor project.

name: Mechanical Engineering
about: Broad mechanical engineering with no fixed specialisation: maths, physics and design first, then fluid dynamics, mechanics, strength of materials, machine elements and energy conversion, with elective blocks in transport, technology or energy.

name: Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
about: One programme joining electrical engineering and computer science, with three branches you can mix freely across: compulsory core courses plus electives, aimed at a master's in Prague or abroad.

name: Mathematical Engineering
about: Classical and modern mathematics with physics and informatics, applied to science and engineering, with specialisations in mathematical physics, mathematical informatics or mathematical modelling.

name: Nuclear and Particle Physics
about: Nuclear, particle and quantum physics with maths, experimental methods and programming; some teaching runs with research partners such as the Czech Academy of Sciences and CERN.

name: Physical Engineering
about: Physics combined with maths and computing through theory, labs and computer work, with specialisations from plasma physics and fusion to solid state, lasers and photonics, and computer physics.

name: Quantum Technologies
about: Quantum mechanics, solid-state physics and laser technology with maths and informatics, plenty of lab work and two foreign-language courses, preparing for quantum, nanomaterial and secure-communication work.

name: Professional Pilot
about: A university degree with integrated ATPL(A) airline-pilot training: theory at the faculty, flying at a partner flight school you choose in your first month, leading to an EASA licence valid across Europe.

name: Biomedical Technology
about: Training as a biomedical technician: maths, physics and chemistry with anatomy and physiology, then medical devices, imaging systems, hospital IT and healthcare technology management; an accredited health profession for work in hospitals.

name: Informatics
about: One computing programme in which you choose a specialisation during your studies: computer engineering, information security, software engineering, networks and internet, computer science, or computer systems and virtualisation.

name: Economics and Management
about: Economics, business and management at CTU's Masaryk Institute of Advanced Studies, with technical electives for modern industry and a three-month company internship in the fifth semester.

name: Computer Science
about: Applied and theoretical computer science on a strong maths base: a common first year, then General Computer Science, Databases and Web, or Artificial Intelligence.

name: Economics and Finance
about: Theoretical and applied economics and finance with serious maths and statistics, taught partly by central-bank and banking professionals; electives in finance, economic policy, trade and European integration.

name: History and Area Studies
about: Modern history, culture and politics of Central Europe, taught in English alongside Czech-language courses that take you to B2 Czech by graduation.

name: Politics, Philosophy and Economics
about: Modelled on Oxford's PPE: three semesters of core courses, then a Politics & Philosophy, Economics & Politics or Philosophy & Economics track.

name: Social Sciences
about: Interdisciplinary social science built on research methods, drawing on sociology, public policy, media studies, political science, anthropology, economics and environmental studies.

name: Sustainability in Marketing and Media Communication
about: Communication, media studies and marketing combined with sustainable development: you create media content and learn to judge the environmental impact of campaigns.

name: Liberal Arts and Humanities
about: An open curriculum centred on philosophy, history and cultural and social anthropology, with few compulsory courses, so you build your own path through the humanities.

name: Psychology
about: Scientific psychology built on the European EuroPsy standard: cognitive, developmental, social and personality psychology, plus clinical, educational and organisational applications.

name: Science
about: Biology, chemistry and physics studied side by side for two years with maths and programming, then a third year specialising in one of the three.

name: Protestant Theology
about: Biblical studies in the original Hebrew and Greek, Christian traditions, world religions, philosophy and ethics, taught in small groups in central Prague.

name: English Language for Teacher Education
about: Linguistics, literature in English and language practice for future English teachers, studied as a major with Music Education or Playing Instrument as your second subject.

name: Music Education for Teacher Education
about: Music pedagogy in theory and practice for future music teachers, combined with English, Choral Singing or Playing Instrument as your second subject.

name: Choral Singing for Teacher Education
about: Conducting technique, reading vocal scores, choir voice training, aural analysis and choral literature, studied as a major with Music Education.

name: Playing Instrument for Teacher Education
about: Piano or violin for musicians aiming to teach rather than perform: individual lessons, chamber music, improvisation and orchestra, with English or Music Education as second subject.

name: Coach
about: Sports coaching grounded in sport science, pedagogy and psychology, specialising in one sport: athletics, gymnastics, swimming, football, ice hockey, volleyball, basketball, tennis, handball or combat sports.

name: Fitness Coach
about: Designing exercise programmes for different groups: exercise physiology, biomechanics, nutrition and training theory, applied in strength training, athletics and gymnastics.

name: Physiotherapy
about: Diagnosis and movement therapy for disorders of the musculoskeletal system, qualifying you as a physiotherapist to WCPT standards, with practice in hospitals, rehabilitation and sport.

name: General Medicine (First Faculty of Medicine)
about: Six-year MUDr. degree at the First Faculty in central Prague; entry is a science test followed by online multiple mini-interviews.

name: General Medicine (Second Faculty of Medicine)
about: Six-year MD in English since 1992, taught at the Plzeňská campus and the Motol and Homolka university hospitals; accredited by the Medical Board of California.

name: General Medicine (Third Faculty of Medicine)
about: Six-year MUDr. degree taught through an integrated curriculum: theory and preclinical subjects are linked, and common clinical problems are taught through problem-based learning.

name: General Medicine (Plzeň)
about: Six-year MUDr. degree in Plzeň: two theoretical years, two preclinical years with bedside teaching from year three, then two clinical years.

name: General Medicine (Hradec Králové)
about: Six-year MUDr. degree with clinical teaching in groups of five to seven at the university hospital, an adaptation programme before you start, and compulsory Czech classes in years 1–2.

name: Dentistry (First Faculty of Medicine)
about: Five-year MDDr. degree in dentistry, including its theoretical fields, at the First Faculty in Prague; entry is a science test followed by online multiple mini-interviews.

name: Dentistry (Plzeň)
about: Five-year MDDr. degree in Plzeň; years three to five are devoted to clinical dentistry, preparing you for general practice or specialisation.

name: Dentistry (Hradec Králové)
about: Five-year MDDr. degree with two students per chair in clinical lessons and training in digital methods such as intraoral scanning, CAD/CAM and 3D printing.

name: Pharmacy
about: Five-year pharmacy degree that meets the EU directive for pharmacists, with elective subjects letting you specialise; taught at the Faculty of Pharmacy in Hradec Králové.

name: Agricultural Engineering
about: Three years of agricultural technology: two years of theory that lead on to technical or biological study, then applied engineering and a bachelor thesis, for farm, forestry and municipal enterprises or a technical master's.

name: Agriculture and Food
about: How food is made from farm to fork: agricultural practice, plant and animal biology, nutrition, soil and microbes, with food quality and technology in the last year and practicals in the university's food facilities and labs.

name: Business Administration
about: Economics, management, commercial law, accounting, psychology and business ethics, taught entirely in English, for careers in management, trade, accountancy, banking and agribusiness, or a follow-on master's.

name: Economics and Management
about: Economics, finance, accounting and agricultural economics, with law, statistics, operations research and informatics, for management roles in firms, services and administration or a follow-on master's.

name: Environmental Data Science
about: Environmental science joined to data science: GIS, programming in R and Python, machine learning, big data and hydrology, with labs, fieldwork and a thesis; compulsory courses in years one and two, electives in year three.

name: Environmental Engineering
about: Environmental protection and natural resource management: earth sciences, environmental chemistry, remediation of contaminated sites and climate-change impacts, with seminars, field workshops and year-three electives.

name: Informatics
about: An IT bachelor taught in English for work in software firms, consulting, finance and public administration, with the option of continuing to a related master's programme.

name: International Cooperation in Agriculture and Rural Development
about: Preparation for international technical-assistance projects in rural development: project management, intercultural communication, biology for agriculture, a personal-security course and compulsory practical training with NGOs, agencies or firms.

name: Sustainable Forestry and Natural Resource Management
about: Forest and non-forest ecosystems, bioeconomy and sustainable natural resource management, with economics, law, GIS, remote sensing and data analysis, and a compulsory semester abroad at a partner university in year two.

name: Sustainable Use of Natural Resources
about: Managing the sustainable use of natural resources with soil and water at the centre and a link to food production; classes, excursions and practical training for government, consultancy or research work, or a master's.

name: Biology and Biochemistry
about: Biology and biochemistry taught together: cell and molecular biology, genetics, microbiology, physiology and chemistry, with lab courses and a bachelor's thesis inside a research group.

name: Data Analytics
about: Mathematical foundations of data analysis with practical data skills, built with industry partners. Taught in combined (part-time) mode and run fully online, so you need not live in Brno.

name: Culture, Media and Performative Arts
about: Film, theatre, new media and culture studied as industries and practices, mixing film and theatre studies, media studies and cultural anthropology, with internships at Czech festivals and media.

name: English Language and Literature
about: English philology in four strands: language skills, linguistics, literary studies and cultural studies of the UK, US, Canada and Australia, ending with a thesis and a state exam.

name: Education for Diversity and Inclusion
about: Education and psychology, social education, and special and inclusive education for future educators, social workers and facilitators, with community work and a one-semester internship.

name: English Language for Education
about: English language, literature and culture for future English teachers, with compulsory teaching practice in real schools already in the bachelor's.

name: Business Management and Finance
about: Management, finance, marketing and economics for a career in business, banking or consulting, with a choice to specialise in finance or management.

name: Economics and Public Policy
about: Economics, public policy and public administration: how governments and the public sector decide, for careers in administration, international organisations, NGOs or policy work.

name: Global Challenges: Society, Politics, Environment
about: Political, social and environmental global challenges studied across political science, environmental studies, social anthropology and sociology, with training in research methods.

name: International Relations and European Politics
about: International relations and European politics: theories of conflict and cooperation, European integration and international political economy, with a strong thread of research methods.

name: Politics, Media, and Communication
about: How politics, the media and society shape each other, combining comparative politics, political theory and political behaviour with new media and mass communication research.

name: General Medicine
about: Six-year medical degree: two years of sciences, anatomy and physiology, then clinical rotations; Czech is taught in years 1–4 so you can talk to patients.

name: Dentistry
about: Five-year dental degree moving from theory through preclinical to clinical subjects, in a credit system that allows part of the study at European partner universities.

name: Pharmacy
about: Five-year integrated pharmacy degree covering drug preparation, pharmacology and pharmacotherapy, and pharmacy law and ethics, with a six-month internship; over half the classes are practical.

name: Chemistry and Technology (Faculty of Chemical Technology)
about: Chemistry and chemical technology at the Faculty of Chemical Technology; during year one you choose catalysis and manufacturing of (in)organic compounds, inorganic, medicinal or organic chemistry, or materials such as glass, metals and polymers.

name: Chemistry and Technology (Faculty of Chemical Engineering)
about: Chemistry and chemical technology at the Faculty of Chemical Engineering; during year one you choose physical and computational chemistry, analytical chemistry or chemical engineering, with early chances to join research teams.

name: Economics and Management
about: Economics, management, marketing and finance for work in international teams, with a Marketing or International Trade concentration; a four-year version adds a first year strengthening English, maths and business terms.

name: Czech for Foreigners
about: Czech language, literature, history and culture taught through English, aiming at B2 Czech, with English skills built up for international careers. It cannot be combined with another programme.

name: English Philology
about: English linguistics, British and American literature and cultural studies, with optional courses that let you specialise in linguistics, literature or translation. Leads on to the English Philology master's.

name: English Language for Education
about: English linguistics, literature including children's literature, and the culture of English-speaking countries, with the theory of teaching English, preparing teaching assistants for pupils aged 5 to 15.

name: Petroleum Engineering
about: Petroleum geoscience and engineering: oil and gas exploration and production, reservoir modelling, drilling, gas storage and geothermal energy, with field, lab and computing work, taught in Olomouc.

name: Physiotherapy
about: A four-year physiotherapy degree with clinical practice from the second year: anatomy, kinesiology, rehabilitation methods and assessment, practised on each other and then on patients.

name: General Medicine
about: The same six-year medical curriculum Czech students follow, taught in English: sciences first, preclinical subjects, then clinical rotations, with Czech lessons in the first three years for talking to patients.

name: Dentistry
about: Five years from the basic sciences through medical subjects to preventive, restorative and surgical dentistry, orthodontics and prosthodontics, with four periods of practice in a dentist's surgery.

name: Biological Chemistry
about: Chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, biophysics and bioinformatics, with a large share of lab work, split about half and half between České Budějovice and JKU Linz; you write two theses and earn two bachelor's degrees.

name: Management and Digital Technology
about: Business economics joined with robotics, digitalisation and AI in production, taught in English in Cheb and at OTH Amberg-Weiden in Bavaria, with two six-month company internships and two degrees at the end.

name: Applied Geology
about: Technically oriented geology covering engineering geology, hydrogeology, geophysics and drilling exploration, training operational geologists for field and laboratory work.

name: Geoinformatics
about: GIS and spatial data: digital cartography, remote sensing, satellite positioning, drones and programming in GIS, with geodesy, databases, field work and a bachelor thesis.

name: Mineral Economics
about: Trade, management and economics of raw materials: how deposits are valued, exploited and processed, using modern software and virtual reality, for industry, finance and public-sector roles.

name: Mining of Mineral Resources
about: Open-cast and underground mining, mineral processing and land reclamation, for work in the raw-materials and construction industries, occupational safety or public bodies.

name: Waste Management and Mineral Processing
about: Processing of mineral resources and of waste and secondary raw materials with a circular-economy focus, plus information science and visualisation for process technologies.

name: Materials Engineering
about: Metals, polymers, structural ceramics and composites: how they are made and processed, and how their structure and properties are tested, with industry projects and internships abroad.

name: Nanotechnology
about: An interdisciplinary bachelor's in the physics and chemistry of nanomaterials: their structure, properties and preparation, for laboratory and industrial work with modern materials.

name: Business Administration
about: How a business is founded, run and grown: management methods, marketing, financial management, sustainability, project work and innovation, with statistics and business data.

name: Finance
about: Banking and insurance, financial analysis, tax systems, financial management and investment decisions, leading on to a master's in Finance or other economics programmes.

name: Financial and Accounting Advisory
about: A professional bachelor's in financial analysis, portfolio management, accounting advice and taxation, for roles in consulting, financial reporting, corporate finance and investment banking.

name: Computer Science
about: Software design and development, computer graphics, databases and systems, and intelligent systems, balancing knowledge and skills, with the option of continuing to a master's in Computer Science.

name: Electrical Engineering
about: Mathematics, physics, theoretical electrical engineering, electronics, measurement and control, communications and power engineering, preparing operational specialists and a follow-on master's.

name: Safety and Security
about: Health, safety and environment, industrial safety, fire protection, crisis management and security management, preparing experts in technical and organisational protection against risks.

name: Finance and Accounting
about: Financial and management accounting, taxation, corporate finance, financial economics and business law, with a corporate project or internship. Accredited by ACCA, with exam exemptions towards its Higher Diploma. First intake September 2027.

name: International Business
about: International business, economics, entrepreneurship, logistics and supply chains, world economy and languages, with an optional third-year double degree at the University of Vaasa (Finland) or OTH Regensburg (Germany).

name: International and Diplomatic Studies
about: International politics, economics and law, comparative politics, diplomatic history and diplomatic practice, with a strong EU focus and quantitative methods including calculus.

name: Business Administration
about: Management-focused business degree: microeconomics, macroeconomics, maths, statistics and law first, then strategy, operations, corporate finance, marketing and entrepreneurship, taught largely through case studies.

name: Economics of Markets and Organizations
about: How markets, competition and industry structures work, taught jointly with the CERGE-EI economics institute (40% of teaching) and aimed at strategy in business and public policy.

name: Economic Data Science
about: Statistics, econometrics and data analysis applied to economic questions, preparing you to analyse and interpret economic data, with an optional study-abroad period in the second or third year.

name: Business Information Systems and Computer Science
about: IT and business together: information systems, web and mobile development, databases and cloud, data, AI and cybersecurity, with a specialisation in data management, innovation or data science. First intake September 2027.

name: Economics
about: Economics with law and other social sciences, weighted towards international economics and politics; taught in English since 2012/13 to students from 24 countries.
